steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Create an RFQ-only event so the counter offer is tested on the RFQ QCS.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the vendor quote.
Invite a vendor whose bid will receive the counter offer.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit the bid that the buyer will counter.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer’s QCS for the RFQ bid.
Send a counter offer to the vendor, creating the pending counter-offer state.
Confirm the QCS marks the vendor’s counter offer as initiated.
Revoke the pending counter offer under the vendor’s QCS column.
Verify the product confirms that the counter offer was revoked.
Verify the vendor no longer has the pending counter-offer tag.
